title.en: Five minutes above the air, timed to a solar flare
title.zh: 飞越大气的五分钟，赶上一场太阳耀斑

summary.en: NASA’s November4 report describes a flare alert system that helped coordinate two2024rocket launches and a2026flight observing three flares. It estimates an already detected flare’s duration; broad forecasting performance and full paper methods remain separate.
summary.zh: NASA11月4日报道，一套耀斑预警系统协助协调2024年的两枚火箭发射，以及2026年观测三次耀斑的一次飞行。系统估计已探测耀斑的持续时间；全面预报表现与论文完整方法仍属另一层证据。

title.en: Europe’s methane rules meet two competing clocks
title.zh: 欧洲甲烷规则，面对两套倒计时

summary.en: The EU Council’s November6negotiating position seeks a one-year postponement for several methane obligations and a readiness review. Parliament’s separate position proposes longer delays. The amendment is still being negotiated; monitoring, reporting dates and intensity limits are distinct.
summary.zh: 欧盟理事会11月6日谈判立场拟将数项甲烷义务延期一年，并设置准备情况评估。议会另有较长延期方案。修法仍在谈判中，监测起点、报告日期与强度上限须分别理解。
